text:
Talia: Who's up for a Saturday morning pancake brunch + charity bike loop? 9:30 meet at bike rack, short 10-mile loop, then pancakes at the courtyard. Bring helmets and a donation for the shelter? 🥞🚲
Marco: Love it. I can bring a pannier with tools and a small first-aid kit. What time do pancakes start?
Ari: Count me in for the ride but I might skip pancakes (work call at noon). Any beginner-friendly pace?
Talia: Easy pace — group rolls together. Pancakes start ~11:30. We'll label donations and have a jar for the shelter.
Nina: I can make vegan pancakes if someone can bring a vegan butter. Also happy to post a quick flyer by the elevators.
Marco: I'll bring the travel-sized stove and syrup. Also bikes with racks welcome.
Ari: ETA 9:20 to warm up. Might borrow a spare pump if anyone has one.
Nina: I have a pump and a handful of extra tubes. Also can bring a picnic blanket.
Marco: Small PSA: wear lights if you have them, the loop includes a tree-lined stretch with shade.
Talia: Donation note: shelter prefers unopened kitty litter and blankets. No cash in envelopes please — we'll pool and deliver.
CleanupBot: Community event created by Talia: "Pancakes & Charity Loop" Saturday 09:30 — Bike rack / Courtyard. Reminder set for 2 hours before.
Ari: Also posting a goofy meme to motivate early rides: https://i.imgur.com/xyzRide.jpg 😂
Nina: Vegan pancakes confirmed. Any nut allergies?
Marco: I'm allergic to tree nuts, please avoid nut-heavy toppings.
Talia: Noted. We'll have a maple and fruit table plus a nut-free stack. See you Saturday — helmets on! 🚴‍♀️🥞
